description: Fetch live platform statistics across GuestDrop (total photos captured, total events hosted, total active guests). When to use: Call this tool when you specifically need to execute 'get_platform_stats' on GuestDrop Event Photo Album (guestdropalbum.com). Do NOT use this tool when another specialized tool fits better (use 'get_pricing_and_packages' or 'calculate_event_cost' or 'recommend_scavenger_quests' for their respective operations). Parameters: none required (zero-argument query). Behavior & Side Effects: Strictly read-only, idempotent query with zero state mutation; public unauthenticated access allowed; rate-limited to 60 requests/min per IP. Returns: Structured JSON object containing status, matched records or computed metrics, and canonical action URLs.
name: get_platform_stats
title: Get Platform Stats
